testcase.system-out: Scenario: Expand and collapse Origin children from its context menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid ✔ And the Origin branch is collapsed in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks Origin ✔ Then its context menu offers Expand All Children and Collapse All Children ✔ When the user chooses Expand All Children ✔ Then Origin displays its plane, axis and center-point child rows ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport ✔ When the user right-clicks Origin and chooses Collapse All Children ✔ Then the direct plane, axis and center-point rows remain visible under Origin ✔ And the solid remains visible in the viewport
